sources.title: 🔱styllEE's Challenger Ivern, RANK 1 peak🔱 SUP + JNG
Season 16 Challenger Ivern Guide (6 Million+ Mastery)

passive.name: Friend of the Forest
passive.text: Ivern cannot attack or be attacked by non-epic monsters. Ivern can create magical groves on jungle camps which grow over time. When the grove is fully grown, Ivern may free the monsters to receive gold and experience.

spells.name: Rootcaller
spells.text: Ivern conjures a vine, dealing damage and rooting enemy targets hit. Ivern's allies can dash to the rooted target.

spells.name: Brushmaker
spells.text: In brush, Ivern and his nearby allies attacks deal bonus magic damage. Ivern can activate this ability to create a patch of brush.

spells.name: Triggerseed
spells.text: Ivern places a shield on an ally which explodes after a short duration slowing and damaging enemies. The shield refreshes if it hits no enemies.

spells.name: Daisy!
spells.text: Ivern summons his Sentinel friend Daisy to fight with him. Re-cast command Daisy to attack or move.

damage.value: Ivern deals sustained bonus magic damage with attacks from brush.

archetype.value: Ivern is a supportive jungler who marks camps with his passive and uses time between collections to influence the map.

winCondition.value: Ivern creates leads by using downtime to track jungle pathing, countergank, secure river control, and pressure objectives.

spikes.why: Ivern gains windows between camp collections to place vision and pressure objectives.
Ivern can solo carry with AP builds.

spikes.at: Triggerseed reaches a 7-second cooldown at rank five
spikes.why: Ivern can shield allies more often.

mistakes.value: Ivern loses map impact by greedily farming every camp instead of adapting his pathing to the game.
Ivern loses damage by fighting without using bushes.
Ivern should learn to control Daisy’s third attack and cancel it when needed.
